item.title: Marion VFW recognizes Mike Absher with plaque
item.description: MARION — Members of the Honor Guard and Ritual Team with Marion VFW Post 1301 presented Mayor Mike Absher with a plaque Thursday for his longstanding support and commitment to the organization.

item.title: SIU alumnae weigh in on Biden’s Student Loan Forgiveness plan
item.description: CARBONDALE – President Joe Biden recently announced that student loan borrowers with incomes below $125,000 a year, or households with incomes below $250,000 a year, will receive $10,000 in federal student loan debt forgiveness. An additional $10,000 will be forgiven…

item.title: Boys Soccer | Second-half goals lift Marion past Murphysboro
item.description: With the win, Marion improves to 2-4 on the season. Murphy falls to 9-2.

item.title: Boys Basketball | Herrin-Benton game now ruled no-contest by IHSA
item.description: The Illinois High School Association ruled Monday that the Herrin-Benton game on Jan. 27 is now a "no contest" rather than a double forfeit.
